name: Queridos Pais
description: The event is a screening of the French-Belgian comedy film "Queridos Pais" (original title: "Chers parents"). It tells the story of Alice and Vincent Gauthier, who gather their three children to announce they won the lottery but do not intend to share the money, leading to family tensions.
longDescription:
The event features the film "Queridos Pais," a French-Belgian comedy directed by Emmanuel Patron. The cast includes André Dussollier, Miou-Miou, and Arnaud Ducret. The movie has a runtime of 86 minutes and is rated M/12 years.

There will be two sessions, at 15:30 and 21:30, at the Cine-Teatro Eduardo Brazão. Tickets are available for purchase online and at sales points via Ticketline, as well as at the municipal theater box offices (AMG and CTEB) from Tuesday to Saturday, 14:30 to 19:00.

Discounts are offered, with 50% off for holders of the Cartão Municipal ViverGaia and Cartão GaiaAmiga. Admission is free for individuals over 65 years old and retirees. The program is subject to changes.
